title: Keeping Body Systems Healthy
seo_title: Grade 5 Science: Keeping Body Systems Healthy Worksheets (Ontario Curriculum)
standard_text: Assess the effects of diet, exercise, sleep and habits such as smoking on organ systems; describe technologies and medical advances that help keep organ systems healthy. (summary of the Ontario Science and Technology curriculum, 2022, Strand B: Life Systems – Human Organ Systems)
meta_desc: Free Grade 5 science worksheets on exercise, healthy eating, Canada's Food Guide, germs, vaccines and habits that harm the body. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Healthy choices keep organ systems working.
key_sub: Being active, eating well, sleeping and avoiding smoking protect your organs.
body_html:
How to think about it

Your choices affect your organ systems.

  • Exercise makes the heart and lungs stronger.
  • Canada's Food Guide: half the plate vegetables and fruits, plus whole grains and protein foods; drink water.
  • Smoking, vaping and second-hand smoke damage the lungs and heart.
  • Handwashing, vaccines and safety gear like helmets protect the body.
Example

Which drink is the best choice?

no added sugar

Answer: water

Example

Why wear a helmet?

protects the skull and brain

Answer: to prevent head injuries

Common mistakes

  • Thinking only adults need exercise.
  • Thinking a food is healthy just because the package says 'natural'.
  • Thinking second-hand smoke is harmless.
